features.name: Postman collections
features.usage: Used canonical Postman collections for FR-04, FR-08, and FR-15, including data-driven requests and optional multi-request state phases while retaining canonical case IDs in execution.

features.name: Postman environment and environment variables
features.usage: Stored the base URL, student ID, credentials, tokens, and baseline state used by the FR-04 and FR-15 collections, Postman Desktop runs, and Newman runs.

features.name: Collection pre-request scripts
features.usage: Injected X-Student-Id: 23127179 into every collection request and constructed case-specific request bodies and authentication modes.

features.name: Postman test scripts and assertions
features.usage: Performed authenticated read-back, persistence, protected-field, cleanup, and state-transition assertions without inventing undocumented response status/schema requirements.

features.name: Data-driven Newman iterations
features.usage: Executed canonical FR-04, FR-08, and FR-15 cases from external JSON data files, with one canonical case ID per iteration and data-controlled optional state phases.

features.name: pm.sendRequest helper requests
features.usage: Issued authenticated read-back and cleanup requests from test scripts to verify persisted state independently of the selected PUT response.

features.name: Newman CLI with JSON and HTML reporters
features.usage: Ran the committed collections with the locked Newman dependency and captured CLI output, raw JSON, HTML, command arguments, hashes, timestamps, and hostnames.

features.name: Postman Console
features.usage: Used the Postman Desktop Console to verify a real request carried X-Student-Id: 23127179.

features.name: Conditional request skipping with pm.execution.skipRequest
features.usage: Let one FR-08 collection cover all 56 executable cases by skipping the secondary-user, second-checkout and cart-rebuild phases per data row, instead of maintaining a separate stateful collection.

features.name: Postman Desktop Collection Runner with an external data file
features.usage: Imported the FR-08 and FR-15 collections into Postman Desktop and drove selected canonical cases through the Collection Runner with external data, confirming canonical case IDs, assertions, cleanup, and the student header in the GUI rather than only in Newman.
